entries.zh: 约定；许诺（口头立约，给出口头承诺）
entries.en: to agree, to covenant (by giving one's word)

entries.zh: 约定；许诺（口头立约，给出口头承诺）
entries.en: to agree, to covenant (by giving one's word)

entries.zh: 断定；议定（裁决、定夺）
entries.en: to decide, to settle (a matter)
entries.notes: L 栏 'concertar ut el que lugar' 中 'ut' 疑为讹写（当作 en el qual lugar），取「议定、定夺」义。

entries.zh: 量；计量（议定分量、称量）
entries.en: to measure (out); to agree on a measure or quantity

entries.zh: 和睦；和好（凭交情相商定）；托付（次要义）
entries.en: to be in harmony, to make peace (through friendship); to entrust (secondary)
entries.notes: L 栏并列 'encargar'（托付），而 H 栏「雍」取和睦义，R 栏 òng 与雍字常读不合，故降为中等。

entries.zh: 密谋；暗中商议（私下策划）
entries.en: to conspire, to plot in secret

entries.zh: 讲价；议价（讨价还价）
entries.en: to bargain over a price, to haggle

entries.zh: 缚定；说定（把条件定死、立定契约）
entries.en: to bind fast, to fix definitively (a settled agreement)
entries.notes: L 栏缩写 'mt′'(=mente)、'concier′'(=concierto) 系依文意展开；H/R 栏「縛定」义明。

entries.zh: 订长年工约；按年受雇（做长工）
entries.en: to engage or hire by the year (as a long-term servant or farmhand)
entries.notes: L 栏 'por emano' 疑为 'por el año'（按年）之讹，与 H/R 栏「縛做長年」（长年雇工）相合。

entries.zh: 包戏；订戏班（雇请戏班演出）
entries.en: to engage a theatrical troupe, to book a performance
entries.notes: L 栏 'come diante‿' 当为 'comediantes'（戏班艺人）之残写，H/R 栏「縛戲」即包戏、订戏。

entries.zh: 诈谋；设局行骗（假意商定以欺骗）
entries.en: to scheme deceitfully, to agree under false pretences in order to deceive
entries.notes: L 栏 'fin gi dam‿ engaⁿar' 残损（谓假意加害、欺骗），据 H/R 栏「詐謀」定释。

entries.zh: 相处；相交（彼此往来共处）
entries.en: to get along with one another, to associate together

entries.zh: 议定；定准（处置裁定）
entries.en: to settle, to determine (a matter)
entries.notes: L 栏 'aslindar' 疑为 'deslindar'（划界、厘定）；H 栏若作「處准（核准）」则义近裁定，暂取「议定、定准」。

entries.zh: 照顾；照应（相处照看）〔西语栏残损，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to look after, to attend to one another (uncertain: corrupt Spanish column)
entries.notes: L 栏 'asogulto' 无法判定对应西语词，仅据 H/R 栏「處顧」推为照顾、照应。

entries.zh: 约束；守约（受约定约束、依约而行）
entries.en: to be bound by agreement, to keep to a compact

entries.zh: 口头定约；说定（以言语订立约定）
entries.en: to make a verbal agreement, to settle by word of mouth
entries.notes: H 栏「斷約」今闽南语多指毁约，此处依 L 栏 'concertarse de palabra'（口头约定）取定约、说定义。

entries.zh: 通谋；串通（勾结商议）
entries.en: to collude, to conspire together

entries.zh: 同谋；合谋（共同策划）
entries.en: to plot together, to be in league

entries.zh: 验定；定准（查验确定、确切议定）
entries.en: to determine definitively, to appraise and fix
entries.notes: L 栏 'c′te yando' 残损（'c′te' 或为 ciertamente 之缩写），据 H/R 栏「監定」取验定、定准义。

entries.zh: 齐整；整理停当（使整齐、安排妥当）
entries.en: to put in order, to arrange neatly; neat, orderly

entries.zh: 成就；办成（圆满达成、成事）
entries.en: to accomplish, to bring to a successful conclusion
entries.notes: L 栏 'venivanell' 尾部残损（疑为 'venir a bien'），据 H/R 栏「成就」取办成、圆满达成义。

entries.zh: 相约；约定（约好会面、彼此订约）
entries.en: to agree to meet, to make an appointment with each other
